_note: Source: UB Student Handbook, Revision No. 7 (issue date April 11, 2023), College Discipline Board Manual, sections 4.1 to 4.6. Offense names are short labels written for the dropdown; the full wording is in handbook/cdb-manual.txt. Categories are the manual's First, Second and Third Degree. Revision No. 8 (2026) does not reprint the manual, so confirm with the SAEP Office that this list is still current before real use, then press 'Sync offense list' on the SAEP All cases page.
